'''''BKFC 35 Myrtle Beach: Cedeno vs. Slaveski''''' was a [[bare-knuckle fighting]] event held by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship on January 27, 2023, at the John T. Rhodes Sports Center in [[Myrtle Beach, South Carolina]], [[United States|USA]].

===Background===
The event featured a welterweight title eliminator bout between [[Yosdenis Cedeno]] and Gorjan Slaveski.<ref name=uno23>{{cite web|url=https://mma.uno/bkfc-debuta-en-carolina-del-sur-el-27-de-enero-con-gorjan-slaveski-vs-yosdenis-cedeno-de-combate-estelar/|title=BKFC debuta en Carolina del Sur el 27 de enero con Gorjan slaveski vs. Yosdenis Cedeno de combate estelar|language=es|date=January 14, 2023|website=mmauno.com|author=Steve Duncan}}</ref>

The event was expected to have a rematch between [[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship#Bantamweight Championship|BKFC Bantamweight Champion]] [[Johnny Bedford]] and former champion [[Dat Nguyen]]; however, the bout was cancelled after Bedford retired from combat sports just a few days into the camp.<ref name=bkfcweekly>{{cite AV media|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W_wtscdf_1s|title= BKFC Holiday Giveaway: $15,000 Cash & Prizes {{pipe}} LIVE! |date=December 21, 2022|via=YouTube|work=[[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship]]}}</ref>

'''''BKFC KnuckleMania 3''''' was a [[bare-knuckle fighting]] event held by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship on February 17, 2023, at the [[Tingley Coliseum]] in [[Albuquerque, New Mexico]], [[United States|USA]].

===Background===
The event was headlined by the BKFC Light Heavyweight Championship unification bout between the reigning champion Lorenzo Hunt and the interim champion [[Mike Richman]]<ref name=mmaf22>{{cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2022/12/21/23521174/lorenzo-hunt-vs-mike-richman-set-as-main-event-for-bkfc-knucklemania-3-on-feb-17|title=Lorenzo Hunt vs. Mike Richman set as main event for BKFC KnuckleMania 3 on Feb. 17|date=December 21, 2022|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Damon Martin}}</ref>

The event also featured the bare-knuckle debut of former [[List of WBA world champions#Secondary champion lineage 6|WBA (Regular) Light Middleweight]] champion [[Austin Trout]] as he faced [[UFC Hall of Fame]]r [[Diego Sanchez]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2023/1/10/23548667/diego-sanchez-makes-bare-knuckle-debut-against-ex-boxing-champ-austin-trout-at-bkfc-knucklemania-3|title=Diego Sanchez makes bare knuckle debut against ex-boxing champ Austin Trout at BKFC KnuckleMania 3|date=January 10, 2023|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Damon Martin}}</ref>

Also, former [[NFL]] defensive end and mixed martial artist [[Greg Hardy]] made his bare-knuckle debut on the card against Josh Watson.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2023/01/bkfc-knucklemania-3-greg-hardy-books-debut-opponent-tbd|title=Greg Hardy to make BKFC debut on Feb. 17 at KnuckleMania 3|date=January 19, 2023|work=[[MMAjunkie.com]]|author=Danny Segura}}</ref> Additionally, the Albuquerque native, [[The Ultimate Fighter 14]] winner and two-time UFC title challenger [[John Dodson (fighter)|John Dodson]] and his brother Eric appeared on the card.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2023/01/bkfc-john-dodson-makes-quick-turnaround-knucklemania-feb-17|title=John Dodson makes quick turnaround from Rizin FF win to fight at 'BKFC: KnuckleMania 3' on Feb. 17|date=January 11, 2023|work=[[MMAjunkie.com]]|author=Mike Bohn}}</ref>

'''''BKFC 56 Utah: Perry vs. Alvarez''''' is a [[bare-knuckle fighting]] event being held by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship on December 2, 2023.

===Background===
This event featured former UFC fighter [[Mike Perry (fighter)|Mike Perry]] against former UFC Lightweight champion [[Eddie Alvarez]] for the inaugural [[Bare_Knuckle_Fighting_Championship#King_of_Violence_Title|King of Violence Championship]]. This also had the bareknuckle debut of former UFC fighter [[Jeremy Stephens]].

A Heavyweight bout between [[Ben Rothwell]] and [[Todd Duffee]] was scheduled for the co-main event. However, on November 30, it was announced the bout was cancelled due to Rothwell having an illness.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2023/11/bkfc-56-ben-rothwell-out-illness-todd-duffee-fight-trageted-february|title=Ben Rothwell out of BKFC 56, fight with Todd Duffee now targeted for February|date=November 30, 2023|author=Danny Segura|publisher=mmajunkie.com}}</ref> The bout was rescheduled for [[2024 in Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship#BKFC 61 Connecticut: Hardy vs. Ferea|BKFC: Knucklemania IV]] on April 27, 2024. A bout between Nick Rossborough and Kevin Brooks was cancelled prior to the event.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tapology.com/fightcenter/bouts/814305-bkfc-56-nick-leatherface-rossborough-vs-kevin-brooks|title=Nick Rossborough vs. Kevin Brooks - Cancelled Bareknuckle Boxing Bout|date=December 2, 2023|author=Tapology|publisher=tapology.com}}</ref>

'''Bonus awards'''

The following fighters were awarded bonuses:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/live/ar1NUzhV2OE?si=GX3HqsYVjSuOBjvH&t=156|title=BKFC 56 UTAH PERRY vs ALVAREZ Press Conference - LIVE - David Feldman announces bonuses|date=December 2, 2023|author=BKFC on YouTube|publisher=youtube.com}}</ref>
